column1: # ema-cashub, standing order 35 (2026-11-15, ~04:30-04:50 CET): the reach of the two form rules (gate-so35-austrian-form-
# checkbox.txt) over every Austrian document with a form block: 187 (all core forms) of the 2,459 served at ~04:25 CET, at
# both widths. Each page-width rendered once as served (so24/host.mjs, EAGER=1 CONSENT=1; www.* and the airline hosts
# refused and counted, none sent); the two rules then added to the page and the page measured again in the same load (so
# Turnstile's challenge, where a load drew it, is in both and cancels out).
# Result: 374 page-widths; none wider than the screen with the rules, no form element past the screen's edge (0 before, 0
# after on every one). 1440: 111 shorter, 51 unchanged, 25 taller (-32 to +16 px; the label's 20 px lines and its tracking).
# 390: 75 shorter, 19 unchanged, 93 taller (-24 to +129 px; the card 20 px narrower, as www's, so long labels and texts take
# more lines: the contact-form-medical-request locales +72 to +129, fluggaeste-mit-betreuungsbedarf +116). Only the five
# gated pages are recorded; the other 182 have no height gate.
